note: The English that stays English in the browser half, one entry per literal, each with the reason it is not copy. The self-check scans the client half for anything that looks like copy and every such literal must be covered here; an entry that covers nothing is itself a failure, and every id must be named in README.md.

entries.why: 诊断行，带上被拒的那个地址；给用户看的那句话是 failure.reason.notFileAddress（已本地化）。

entries.match: session address without an id or a path
entries.why: 同上：诊断行带数据（地址），人名由 failure.reason.malformed 承担。

entries.match: address segment is not validly encoded
entries.why: 同上：这是 URI 转义解析器的原话，人名由 failure.reason.malformed 承担。

entries.match: an absolute file address carries no Session to read through
entries.why: 同上：诊断行说明为什么读不了，人名由 failure.reason.absoluteScope 承担。
同上：诊断行带 scope 原值，人名由 failure.reason.unknownScope 承担。
分页收口的读数（offset 与行数），人名由 failure.reason.noProgress 承担。
